parsed.why: Decriminalised, regionally tolerant, protective diplomatic posture, no state hostility; only undated attacks reported by one activist. No trans-specific border/facility exposure documented; absence of legal gender recognition is a resident gap, not visitor exposure.

Enforced sodomy statute with 2023 arrests and prison sentences, president urging stoning, death in detention, unregistered NGOs, no protection from discrimination amid general state violence. Outing risks custody with severe abuse.

Same-sex lawful but state cancelled an LGBTQ event and in 2025 rejected recommendations to combat anti-LGBT violence; gender identity named as marriage-nullity ground; documented social unacceptability and dated anti-trans violence with no remedy.

Constitutional gender-identity protection, anti-discrimination law, hate-crime aggravator, trans-supportive polling; no visitor-facing restriction. Weak enforcement and documented exclusion, but no state hostility toward outed trans travellers.

2024 judicial decriminalisation shows working courts, but police dismiss anti-LGBT violence, a killing with slurs, hostility to gay tourists, no gender-identity protection, and no trans-specific data either way.
